Elise v1.0.8 fixes the initial authentication gap across every protocol using the shared node runner, including VLESS, VMess, AnyTLS, and Hysteria 1/2.

- Fetch and apply panel users and their limits before opening the listener, instead of waiting for the first polling interval. Fetch device counts before opening the listener as well.
- Retry failed initial user requests every 10 seconds without accepting clients prematurely. Shutdown cancels waiting requests and retries. A valid empty list starts normally with no authorized users.
- Keep the last valid users on later fetch failures and reuse them during listener/certificate reloads. Valid empty responses revoke access for new authentication attempts.
- Log initial readiness and user counts at info, along with count changes and recovery. Routine counts stay at debug; repeated user-fetch failures are summarized at exponentially spaced failure counts.
- Correct the master startup message so spawning node tasks is not presented as listener readiness.

Upgrade with `sudo elisectl update`, then verify `elise --version` reports `1.0.8`. Updating briefly interrupts active connections. The fix applies to both V2Board modes and the other panel adapters; no panel or protocol configuration change is required.

See the [installation instructions](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.8/README.md#installation) and [startup/logging behavior](https://github.com/phungvanquy/elise/blob/v1.0.8/README.md#logs-and-debugging).
